comment: The three-layer model uses “content and application layer” for clinical systems, analytics platforms, and applications. This combines governed content with the systems that consume it, although content artefacts also exist in the governance and runtime layers.

anchor.note: p.58 l.Lines 418-430 read as the printed page; section 3.4.5 agrees

public.text: The three-layer model uses “content and application layer” for clinical systems, analytics platforms, and applications. This combines governed content with the systems that consume it, although content artefacts also exist in the governance and runtime layers.
public.suggestedRevision: Rename the third layer Consumption, implementation, and feedback layer, and represent governed content as flowing from authoring and publication into runtime distribution and consuming implementations.
